integrity_notes: Known beta entropy, Gaussian maximum entropy and order-statistic identities are explicitly attributed. An updated, closely related 2023 journal treatment remains a priority-access risk; results have not undergone independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Proves only symmetric Beta(a,a) laws with a>0 and forward KL divergence to unrestricted Gaussian families. Not asserted for asymmetric beta laws, arbitrary sample-median parents or reverse KL.
title: Strict Gaussian negentropy monotonicity for symmetric beta laws
